meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: Claude 会读取仓库里全部 open 的 issue 和 PR，逐条并行后台分析，把报告写到 /tmp/时间戳/ 目录，每条结论都附 GitHub permalink 作证据，且绝不对 GitHub 做任何写操作。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”、“triage issues” 等词时触发；它接管仓库中所有 open 条目，逐条分派后台任务分析。

say.text: triage 一下这个仓库的 issues
say.note: 每个 issue 生成一份分析报告

say.text: 帮我 triage 所有 open 的 PR
say.note: 逐个 PR 输出审查报告到 /tmp
按 Bug 类型分析并给出判定

howto.what_en: Claude reads every open issue and PR in the repo, analyzes each in its own background task, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim cites a GitHub permalink, and it never writes to GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues" or similar; it takes over all open items in the repo, one background task per item.

say_en.text: Triage the issues in this repo
say_en.note: Writes an analysis report per issue
Outputs a review report per PR to /tmp
